clothoid_design — DRIVE lateral op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.clothoid_design(radius: 'float', length: 'float', speed: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, float]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelateral; drivelateral.clothoid_design(radius: 'float', length: 'float', speed: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, float]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("clothoid_design"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

直線 → 円(半径 R)を長さ L のクロソイドで繋ぐときの量。

返り値: A = √(R L)、end_angle τ = L/(2R)、end_point(終点の (x, y)、フレネル積分)、shift ΔR = y_end − R(1 − cos τ)(円が直線から離れる量。近似 L²/(24R))、lateral_jerk(速さ v を与えたとき v³/(R L) [m/s³] = Shortt 式の P)、min_length_3s(v を与えたとき 3 秒の走行長 3v [m])。

Raises ValueError: R ≤ 0、L ≤ 0、v ≤ 0。
